visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot inside a car, showing an adult's hands holding a holographic photo card featuring four portraits of a male celebrity. The background includes car interior details like a grey bag and a blue cardboard box. (2) The camera shifts to the back seat where a young boy with short dark hair, wearing a yellow shirt with cartoon bear patterns, leans forward. He places his hand beside his mouth, whispering intently into the adult's ear with a serious facial expression. (3) The shot cuts back to the photo card being held over the adult's lap, then back to the boy who continues his hushed conversation, his eyes looking up at the adult. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from outside the vehicle. (4) The final sequence shows the car's center console with a water bottle as the boy sits back, looking toward the camera while the adult speaks, concluding the interaction with a view of the child in the background.

(4) [Subtitle]: 等媽媽上車 就問她 你給我好好解釋 為什麼放別人⋯剛⋯ 其他男人的照片. (5) [Subtitle]: 哦⋯好 沒問題. (6) [Subtitle]: 那你先放在 你褲子那邊. (7) [Subtitle]: 你是有看過連續劇嗎？ 八點檔你有看過喔？！.
